m15_mapping.scale_status: engineering_layout_scale: one target-square unit represents M1 100mm staging square, not a measurement of real target
m15_mapping.source_coordinate_schema: raw pixels; normalized image; dimensionless target-unit homography

synthetic_control.matching: one independent draw per usable personal episode, matched category and robot/settings

m15_mapping.yaw_equation: project numeral-up vector through local homography; swap unit axes; yaw=atan2(-dx,dy)+world_rotation; retain directed 2pi angle

task.instruction: Grasp the orange block, orient its blue 2, and place it in the staging square.

canonical_robot_episode.instruction: Grasp the orange block, orient its blue 2, and place it in the staging square. Target centre in robot world metres: x=0.125000, y=-0.120000. Required block yaw: 0.000000 degrees about world +z; yaw 0 means the upper edge of blue 2 points world +y.
canonical_robot_episode.proprio: measured EE on first window; previous commanded absolute target thereafter, matching M2 action-history interface
canonical_robot_episode.window: 30 future20Hz absolute targets; last target repeats only past terminal boundary; observation sampled before first action
